name: io.github.cahthuranag/mcp-server
title: AllRatesToday
description: Real-time & historical exchange rates for 160+ currencies via AllRatesToday (mid-market). Works with no API key.

environmentVariables.name: ALLRATES_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Without it the server runs keyless: get_exchange_rate answers from the official ECB daily reference table (~30 majors) and list_currencies works. A free key (https://allratestoday.com/register) unlocks real-time mid-market rates for 160+ currencies, historical series, and multi-target/point-in-time lookups.
